instrument: Texas SB 6, Section 6 (wholesale transmission cost methodology)
summary: The PUC must evaluate whether the four-coincident-peak methodology and retail ratemaking appropriately assign transmission costs, and must amend its rules by December 31, 2026 so wholesale transmission charges appropriately assign costs for transmission investment.

source.citation: Texas SB 6 (89th Leg., enrolled; effective June 20, 2025), LegiScan mirror

next.event: Texas PUC deadline to amend wholesale transmission cost rules (SB 6 Sec. 6)
